sn48.53:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
sn48.53:1.4: atthi nu kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajāneyya asekkho bhikkhu asekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito asekkhosmīti pajāneyyāti.
sn48.53:2.2: atthi bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajāneyya asekkho bhikkhu asekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito asekkhosmīti pajāneyya.
sn48.53:3.1: katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:3.2: idha bhikkhave sekkho bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
sn48.53:3.3: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekkho bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati
sn48.53:4.2: atthi nu kho ito bahiddhā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yo evaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ dhammaṃ deseti yathā bhagavāti.
sn48.53:4.4: natthi nu kho ito bahiddhā añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yo evaṃ bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ dhammaṃ deseti yathā bhagavāti.
sn48.53:4.5: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sekkho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni pajānāti
sn48.53:5.3: yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni na heva kho kāyena phusitvā viharati
sn48.53:5.5: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma sekkho bhikkhu sekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito sekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:6.1: katamo ca bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma asekkho bhikkhu asekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito asekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:6.2: idha bhikkhave asekkho bhikkhu pañcindriyāni pajānāti.
sn48.53:6.4: yaṃgatikāni yaṃparamāni yaṃphalāni yaṃpariyosānāni kāyena ca phusitvā viharati
sn48.53:6.6: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma asekkho bhikkhu asekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito asekkhosmīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:7.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave asekkho bhikkhu cha indriyāni pajānāti
sn48.53:7.2: cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ manindriyaṃ.
sn48.53:7.3: imāni kho cha indriyāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjhissanti aññāni ca cha indriyāni na kuhiñci kismiñci uppajjissantīti pajānāti.
sn48.53:7.4: ayaṃpi kho bhikkhave pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma asekkho bhikkhu asekkhabhūmiyaṃ saṇṭhito asekkhosmīti pajānātīti.
